data.name: Arsh
data.gender_notes: Arsh is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Arsh is a powerful Arabic name meaning 'Throne', referring to the divine throne of Allah in Islamic belief. It symbolizes spirituality, authority, and a connection to the celestial realm. The name Arsh carries the meaning “Throne of Allah, Heaven” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Arsh usually hope their child will grow to embody throne of allah, heaven and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents divine closeness, spiritual leadership, and a noble soul aligned with higher purpose.
data.etymology: Arsh belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Throne of Allah, Heaven.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arsh total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: The name Arsh has a rich cultural significance in Islamic tradition. Symbols of thrones and regality are often used in Islamic art and calligraphy to represent Allah's sovereignty and power. The notion of an all-powerful, ruling deity is a fundamental aspect of monotheistic belief systems, including Islam, and the representation of such concepts through the use of names like Arsh serve as constant reminders of this divine power and authority.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Arsh represents the seat of Allah's infinite wisdom, mercy, and compassion. Muslims believe that Allah's throne is above the heavens, and He is in control of all things in the universe. The name Arsh serves as a reminder of our submission to and dependence on Allah, as well as a source of inspiration to strive towards living a life that brings us closer to our Creator. Ultimately, the name Arsh evokes feelings of awe, reverence, and deep devotion towards the Almighty.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Arsh in Islamic tradition represents the Throne of Allah, signifying His majesty, power, and sovereignty over the entire universe. It is a reminder of His ultimate control and the reality of His divine presence above all creation.
